verdict.rationale: Azure documents budgets and cost/forecast-based alerts configurable via Cost Management (azure-docs-13) plus APIs for multidimensional cost/usage analysis (azure-docs-14, azure-docs-22, azure-docs-30), giving founders day-one spend controls. However, the pack contains no explicit documentation of automated anomaly detection on spend, and community comments describe surprise/opaque billing experiences (azure-comm-16, azure-comm-18) suggesting real-world friction with cost visibility. Missing for 10: explicit anomaly-detection feature docs, and independent confirmation that budget alerts reliably prevent bill surprises.
